checks.sqltext: expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > starts_at

views.vw_matter_access_registry:
SELECT m.id AS matter_id,
    a.id AS account_id,
    a.username,
    o.code AS organization,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM matter_assignments g
              WHERE (((g.matter_id)::text = (m.id)::text) AND ((g.account_id)::text = (a.id)::text) AND (g.revoked = false) AND (g.starts_at <= (EXTRACT(epoch FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))::bigint) AND (g.expires_at > (EXTRACT(epoch FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))::bigint)))) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS assigned,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM ethical_walls w
              WHERE (((w.matter_id)::text = (m.id)::text) AND ((w.account_id)::text = (a.id)::text) AND (w.active = true)))) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS blocked
   FROM ((matters m
     CROSS JOIN accounts a)
     JOIN organizations o ON (((o.id)::text = (a.organization_id)::text)))
  WHERE ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM matter_assignments g
          WHERE (((g.matter_id)::text = (m.id)::text) AND ((g.account_id)::text = (a.id)::text)))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM ethical_walls w
          WHERE (((w.matter_id)::text = (m.id)::text) AND ((w.account_id)::text = (a.id)::text)))));
views.vw_client_matter_validation:
SELECT m.id AS matter_id,
    m.name AS matter_name,
    c.id AS client_id,
    c.name AS client_name,
    c.client_number,
    v.matter_number,
    (((c.client_number)::text || '-'::text) || (v.matter_number)::text) AS client_matter_number,
    v.status AS validation_status,
    v.revision
   FROM ((matters m
     JOIN matter_validations v ON (((v.matter_id)::text = (m.id)::text)))
     JOIN clients c ON (((c.id)::text = (v.client_id)::text)));
views.vw_document_policy_state:
SELECT matter_id,
    document_id,
    source_hash,
    resource_type,
    classification,
    classification_confirmed,
    review_state,
    released,
    audience,
    quarantined,
    superseded,
    signing_frozen,
    ai_restricted,
    clean_team_scope,
    sanitized,
    antitrust_approved,
    approved_snapshot_hash,
    id
   FROM document_policy_versions;
views.vw_person_wall_entries:
SELECT c.id,
    c.client_id,
    c.matter_id,
    c.entry_type,
    c.account_id,
    c.role_name,
    c.relationship_kind,
    c.starts_at,
    c.expires_at,
    c.proposed_by,
    c.retire_id,
    c.rationale,
    c.created_at
   FROM (wall_controls c
     JOIN wall_control_decisions d ON ((((d.control_id)::text = (c.id)::text) AND ((d.decision)::text = 'approve'::text))))
  WHERE (((c.entry_type)::text <> 'retirement'::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM (wall_controls r
             JOIN wall_control_decisions rd ON ((((rd.control_id)::text = (r.id)::text) AND ((rd.decision)::text = 'approve'::text))))
          WHERE (((r.retire_id)::text = (c.id)::text) AND ((r.entry_type)::text = 'retirement'::text))))));

views.vw_wall_document_references:
SELECT p.id AS policy_id,
    p.matter_id,
    s.id AS source_version_id,
    s.version_number
   FROM (document_policy_versions p
     LEFT JOIN source_versions s ON (((s.policy_id)::text = (p.id)::text)));
